cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. We wanted somewhere to belong. This leaking cottage can still be ours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The roof needs replacing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then we'll know every tile of the place we belong.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It may cost our savings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We hoped for a home, not an untouched savings account beside someone else's house.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We hoped for a home, not an untouched savings account beside someone else's house.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We said the concert would bring the village together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The power's out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll sing together without microphones.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Half the audience has gone home for torches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look at that. The village is already supplying its own light.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Someone as capable as you must have wonderful doors waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you asking me to leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm making sure you won't mistake this doorway for your last opportunity.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The lift costs petrol and a proper conversation about why you stopped calling.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we discuss it another day?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then today costs petrol and another postponed conversation. The second price is rising.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You said 'nothing can go wrong' before balancing the key on the teacup.

beats.text: It fell into the cup. I dried it with the invitation.

beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And now the invitation has dissolved around the key to the wedding hall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can still prise it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Your 'nothing' has become both the lock and the address we can't read.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember calling the spare chair unnecessary before giving its place to the cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake needed somewhere flat.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's managed perfectly well.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until we open that window to cool the cake. Every sensible decision is now sitting on the next one.
